title: Origins: Shanks
body:
This datapack adds custom knife-like weapons into the game using the Origins mod.

For the (awesome) knife textures please download the attached resource pack.

Made for the 2025 Origins: Home Sweet Home jam

## Knives
Knives are weak but fast weapons, and have some abilities that distinguish them from other weapons.

**Parry**

Knives have the ability to parry certain attacks and protectiles by timing a right-click within 3 game ticks (0.15 seconds) before being damaged, negating all damage, dealing 4 relatiation damage and pushing the attacker away. This ability has a cooldown of 2 seconds, but will be reset upon successfully performing a parry. This ability also damages the weapon if an attack connects.

**Backstab**

Knives deal 80% more damage when attacking from behind an enemy.

**Stealth**

Knives also deal 50% more damage when attacking an enemy not currently targeting you.

## Items
Currently, the datapack adds two custom knife weapons.
### Shank
![Shank item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f9a88af62f413bb25f10d0ef1a58cc8a64be982.png)

A weak makeshift knife.
Deals 3 points of damage and has an attack speed of 3, with durability equivalent to a stone sword.

![Shank crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84c3b4844b2e9b7b5e625080eef8454925581835.png)

### Combat Knife
![Combat Knife item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e25ed47b9de120d0bf9b20d0c929757c8465a519.png)

A superior knife.
Deals 5 points of damage and has an attack speed of 3, with durability equivalent to a netherite sword.

![Combat Knife crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f49fd143141ceeaf25425660670292876cae442.png)
